preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The length of the sequence n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each number in the sequence must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if all(abs(a[i] - (i + 1)) <= 1 for i in range(n)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if all numbers are at most 1 position away from their correct sorted position, otherwise output 'NO'.
